title: At the Doctor's
intro: What's the matter? You should see a doctor.

words.sentence: You've got a cold. You should stay in bed.
words.def: When you have got this, you sneeze and your nose runs.

words.sentence: You've got a cough. You should drink some warm water.
words.def: When you have got this, you make a loud noise from your throat.

words.sentence: You've got a headache. You shouldn't watch TV.
words.def: When your head hurts, you have got this.

words.sentence: You've got a stomach-ache. You shouldn't eat sweets.

parentTip.vi: Khi con mệt, hỏi "What's the matter?" và gợi ý lời khuyên "You should drink some water."

chat.ask: Do you go to bed early when you are ill?
chat.yes: Good! You should rest when you are ill.
chat.no: You should! Rest helps you get better.

gaps.s: You've got a ___. You should go to bed and sneeze into a tissue.
You've got a ___. You shouldn't look at your computer.

text.title: A Visit to the Doctor
lines: On Monday, Lucy felt ill. She had a cough and a headache.
Her mum took her to the doctor.
The doctor said, "You should stay at home for two days and drink lots of water."
On Thursday, Lucy felt better and went back to school.

questions.q: What was the matter with Lucy?
When did she go back to school?
